title: Effects
summary: Scripted set pieces, the same in every theme. Unlike a filter (a look over the shot, any length, an amount dial), an effect brings its own content — title, cards, reels, a background — and its own few-second timeline, and takes over the frame while it plays.
usage: In a footage storyboard, as an effect entry that spans the moment: {"name": "gta6_poster", "at": 0, "seconds": 3, "where": "all", "amount": 1, "props": {"text": "CLAUDE|DID THIS"}}. Engine: library/_shared/signature.py.

items.name: gta6 poster
items.description: A game-cover poster of the person: cel shading on a sunset with a heavy outline, the hook in bold type and a loading spinner, then it snaps live. Options ("props"): text (hook lines split with |), label (LOADING), scale (the person's size, 0.6–1).

items.name: text behind, slice
items.description: A colour card with a big title behind the person; on the cue a cut line slices it and the halves slide apart to reveal the shot (a fixed look, the same in every theme). Prefer a title in the storyboard theme: a text overlay with "behind": "person" and "exit": "slice" (README: Behind the person, and the slice exit). Options ("props"): text (lines split with |), at (seconds in when it slices; 60% in), angle (-9), color (#2F5BEA), y (title bottom, 0–1; .37), stagger (.22).

items.name: reel fly-through
items.description: Full-screen cutaway: the shot shrinks into a card, the camera flies through playing reels, they stack into a column and the last card grows back to full screen. Options ("props"): clips (folder of reels; sample reels by default), text (titles "Title::sub|…"), sub, column (3), count (16), bg, bg2, look ("gta6"), seed. Give it 4–6 s.

items.name: ai prompt
items.description: A chat composer above the head types the ask as it is said, shows a slash-command suggestion, then sends and marks it Sent. Options ("props"): text (the ask, typed), label (To Claude), suggest (slash-command chip; "" hides it), type_end, send_at (seconds), accent, ink, paper. Card above the head.

items.name: edit preview
items.description: Full-screen cutaway: the shot shrinks into an "Editing with…" card on the brand grid and plays sped up with a shimmer and a progress line, then grows back. Options ("props"): video (clip played sped up in the card; the shot itself by default), speed (3), text (Editing with reel-edit…), accent, highlight, background. Full-screen cutaway.

items.name: raw vs edit
items.description: RAW and EDITED cards play the same moment side by side on the brand grid; the edited one (punch-in, grade, caption, title sticker) grows to full screen. Options ("props"): grow_at (seconds; 58% in), punch (edited zoom, 1.3), caption (*word* highlighted; "" = none), title (sticker; "" = none), color/accent, highlight, ink, background. Full-screen.

items.name: feed scroll
items.description: A phone-style card above the head swipes up through reels like the real feed, each with its view count. Options ("props"): clips (folder or |-list of reels/covers; sample reels by default), text (view counts with |), count (3), size (card width 0–1, .36), at (cover second, 1). Card above the head.

items.name: storyboard pages
items.description: Storyboard pages above the head: a thumbnail, each shot's line and a note per row; the pages flip. Options ("props"): text (shots "line::note|…", 3 per page), title, video + shots (thumbnail clip and seconds with |; the live shot by default), accent, ink, paper. Card above the head.

items.name: insights zoom
items.description: A reel-insights card slides in above the head, the numbers count up, the camera pushes into the views row and a highlighter sweeps under the number. Options ("props"): text (rows "Label::value|…", the first is highlighted), title (Reel insights), sub (Last 30 days), growth (38%), zoom (1.35), accent, highlight, ink, paper.

items.name: catalog grid
items.description: End card: Comment "KEYWORD" and a pill over a numbered grid of reels that fills in tile by tile. Options ("props"): text (keyword), total (15), sub, clips (tile pictures; sample reels by default), labels (|), cols (4), rows (3), step (.1), accent, highlight, ink, background. Full-screen end card.

items.name: lines of light
items.description: The room drops to near-black teal and thin neon lines (red and blue fringes, white core) draw an editing timeline behind the person; on the cue it is struck out and NO TIMELINE lands. Options ("props"): shape (timeline), at (seconds of the cue; 62% in), label (TIMELINE), text (NO TIMELINE), height (.2).
